chapter: Meeting Jay McShann and Martin's on the Plaza
title: McShann's age and personality
summary: Ramey, three years older, was the oldest in the band; Jay looked young, friendly, now more business-like.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Now, were you -- in those days, of course, McShann would have been still in his twenties. No, 1916 he says he was born.
Yeah, I'm three years older than McShann. I was the oldest one in his band. He was about -- I'd say like he was McShann really looked younger than he was, and acted it, too, you know.
Yeah. Very friendly, and always, you know -- knew no strangers, you know.
That's his personality to this day, sort of happy-go-lucky.
Yeah, but he's pretty much business now. And I tell him he's like a sly old fox now. He's made -- got some money.
